ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["I want to share my recent experience at Inverclyde Royal Hospital A&E because I am genuinely worried about the quality of care I received.

Yesterday, I attended A&E with chest pain radiating to my left arm, jaw, and left side of my neck. I am currently waiting for a CT coronary angiogram, and I was admitted two weeks ago for exertional chest pain. Since then, I have been placed on cardiac medications including Bisoprolol.

However, since last Wednesday, I have been experiencing the same chest pain even at rest, and the only thing that reduces it is GTN spray. This pain has been repeating daily.

Because of this ongoing issue, I’m not able to walk properly, work properly, or even handle small emotional stress. My quality of life has genuinely dropped in the past two weeks.

When I went to A&E, they did an ECG and blood tests which came back normal. Despite explaining the whole history, my cardiac risk factors, my family history, and the fact that the pain is relieved by GTN, the doctor told me he did not think it was cardiac.

I was asked to go for an X-ray and was left halfway along the corridor and told to find my own way. I returned to my bed after completing the X-ray independently, and only afterwards did the porter arrive.

I spent 4–5 hours in A&E and was given two doses of GTN spray, as well as Aspirin and Ibuprofen — yet not a single set of vital signs was taken again after GTN, despite its risk of causing hypotension.

The doctor’s final advice was simply to “manage with GTN spray” and go home. He stated I was not having a heart attack, therefore no further intervention was needed — even though this pain has been ongoing for days and is worsening.

As a nurse with cardiology experience, I know that normal ECGs and initial blood tests do not rule out all cardiac problems, especially when symptoms are repeated and relieved by GTN.

I left the hospital feeling dismissed, unsafe, and unheard. I am 32 years old, but that does not mean cardiac symptoms should be taken lightly.

My sincere question is: Do patients need to reach the point of a cardiac arrest or heart attack before being taken seriously?",null,[0,138]]]],[null,null,null,null,null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/17890033883981357727/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnhPUkU5WVdYcFVWekZZVlRKa1VtVklRWGxXVlVsNlRtdGFWMVF5WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/17890033883981357727/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnhPUkU5WVdYcFVWekZZVlRKa1VtVklRWGxXVlVsNlRtdGFWMVF5WXhBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/17890033883981357727/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnhPUkU5WVdYcFVWekZZVlRKa1VtVklRWGxXVlVsNlRtdGFWMVF5WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/17890033883981357727/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnhPUkU5WVdYcFVWekZZVlRKa1VtVklRWGxXVlVsNlRtdGFWMVF5WXhBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/17890033883981357727/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnhPUkU5WVdYcFVWekZZVlRKa1VtVklRWGxXVlVsNlRtdGFWMVF5WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/17890033883981357727/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnhPUkU5WVdYcFVWekZZVlRKa1VtVklRWGxXVlVsNlRtdGFWMVF5WXhBQhAA"]],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xORE9YWXpUVzFYVTJkUmVIQXlWVUl6TmtaV1QyYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xf45513277f77d0ad!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOlNDOXYzTW1XU2dReHAyVUIzNkZWT2c%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xORE9YWXpUVzFYVTJkUmVIQXlWVUl6TmtaV1QyYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjLleqU9beTAxXUL3sEHUUVHsQQoykIHygB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjLleqU9beTAxXUL3sEHUUVHsQQ0pMFCB0oCQ"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFDaHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMVp3TldWNmQxOWZSV2hDZEZGaFdUVTBSMmxHZEZObllUQllkMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpUWjBOYVYyNXNOMUJCV1VGRFNVRQ=="]]]
